description: This file defines the VacancyDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for managing Vacancy entities in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying vacancies with various filters and conditions.

classes.name: VacancyDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Vacancy entities, enabling CRUD operations and complex queries related to job vacancies.

methods.name: getVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of vacancies based on the specified search filter parameters.

methods.name: getVacancyListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for listing vacancies with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: getVacanciesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query with filters based on VacancySearchFilterParams, including joins and conditions, returning a query builder wrapper.

methods.name: saveJobVacancy
methods.description: Saves a Vacancy entity to the database.

methods.name: getVacanciesCount
methods.description: Counts vacancies matching the search filter criteria.

methods.name: getVacancyById
methods.description: Retrieves a Vacancy entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyIds
methods.description: Fetches existing vacancy IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: getHiringManagerEmpNumberList
methods.description: Returns list of hiring manager employee numbers based on search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of all vacancy IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves list of vacancy IDs for a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if an employee number corresponds to an active hiring manager.

methods.name: isActiveJobTitle
methods.description: Checks if a job title ID corresponds to an active (non-deleted) job title.

methods.name: isActiveHiringManger
methods.description: Verifies if a hiring manager with given employee number is active.
